notes: One row per exact grant, project, original activity and observed report quarter in a selected set of approved public QPR versions. Not a complete activity or quarter census.
Implied opening is QPR to-date minus QPR this-period in that document version. It is a diagnostic, not proof of grant-start zero or an audited balance.

Only an immediately preceding listed activity-quarter can be compared. Different source vintages, revisions or corrections can produce a difference; preserve it, never interpolate or replace either source.
A missing earlier activity-quarter is unavailable, not zero or evidence the activity did not exist. Q1 is the calendar quarter containing initial execution and can be partial.
F31 columns are an independently sourced exact same-key comparison; do not add, splice or silently overwrite QPR and F31. National and Texas F31 snapshots overlap.
Government identity is administrative; beneficiary geography and local allocation remain blank. Values are nominal integer USD cents and negative adjustments are preserved.
